en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing the façade of a grand multi‑storey hotel building with ornate balconies and arched windows. A covered entrance canopy extends toward the street, with trees and people visible in the foreground. At the top of the building the sign reads "Grand Continental", and printed text on the right identifies the scene as the Continental Hotel in Cairo. A modern website watermark appears along the bottom.
